column1: # Colosso arena: spectators, Lucky Guess crowd, entrance staff, named contestants, finalists, post-event.
# Shared MsgXianItIsLocked deliberately excluded; rule instructions in Colosso match stages unmodified.

column3: The arena's full. If you\nwant a seat now, you'll\nhave to pay one of those{page_break}ticket resellers.{end_wait}
Trying to get inside for\nColosso?{end_now}
I saved enough for a\nticket, but not for a good\nseat. Those prices are{page_break}absurd.{end_wait}
Lucky Guess makes the\nmatches more exciting.\nPeople cheer for whoever{page_break}they've picked.{end_wait}
Hold it! Where do you think\nyou're going?{end_wait}
I backed the fighter no one\nelse wanted. If he wins, I\nwon't have to work for a{page_break}month.{end_wait}

Sorry. We can't let the
finalists or their
teammates take part in{page_break}Lucky Guess. Those are the
rules.{end_wait}
Want to try Lucky Guess?{end_now}
Do you know how Lucky Guess\nworks?{end_now}

They ranked me second.
Second! I'm Azart, and I'm
going to prove they got it{page_break}wrong. So you're Babi's
chosen fighter?{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Waaah!{reset_text_style} You nearly scared me\nout of my skin!{end_wait}
You came to speak with me?\nThen you must be {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Dekka will win. Dekka must\nwin. Don't forget that\nname.{end_wait}
I'm Navampa, from Gondowan.\nSixth seed. I didn't come\nthis far to lose quietly.{end_wait}
Buford. Seventh seed.\nThat's all you need to\nknow.{end_wait}
Ready for the finals?{end_now}
Wait. You're {actor_name:1},\naren't you?{end_wait}
We've been standing here\nforever. Start the finals\nalready!{end_wait}
That fighter cleared the\ntrial. It takes skill to\nget this far, but the{page_break}finals are another matter.{end_wait}
What?!{end_wait}
That warrior failed the\ntrial. There's no place for\nhim in the finals now.{end_wait}
Only {actor_name:1} is entering?\nWhat happened to everyone\nelse?{end_wait}
Contestants, take your\nplaces! The finals are\nabout to begin!{end_wait}
So, you won your first\nmatch. Don't let it go to\nyour head.{end_wait}
Two wins. One more and this\nwhole crowd will know your\nname.{end_wait}
That's it! Keep going! I'm\ncheering for you!{end_wait}
The trials are better than\nI expected. Those fighters\nmake every obstacle look{page_break}dangerous.{end_wait}
I came for swordplay.\nWatching the trials has\nbeen just as good.{end_wait}
I've waited all year for\nColosso. I won't miss a\nsingle match.{end_wait}
Don't count the smaller\nfighters out. A big man can\nstill trip over his own{page_break}feet.{end_wait}
Those trials test more than\nmuscle. You can tell which\nfighters think before they{page_break}move.{end_wait}
Look at the size of them! I\nused to be built like that.\nMore or less.{end_wait}
The trial matches were\nrough enough. The finals\nmust be something else.{end_wait}
No matter how good you are,\nsomeone better might be\nwaiting in the next match.{end_wait}
The preliminary trials are\nunderway. Only those who\nclear them can reach the{page_break}finals.{end_wait}
The finals at last! I've\nbeen waiting for the best\nfighters to face each{page_break}other.{end_wait}
Colosso is over. The\narena's closed until next\nyear. You can still admire{page_break}the gates, I suppose.{end_wait}
Not a seat left in the\narena. I should've come\nearlier.{end_wait}
Babi picked a fighter for\nthe finals himself. I'd\nlike to see what makes that{page_break}one special.{end_wait}
No entry. The arena is shut\nuntil next year's Colosso.{end_wait}
People win big at Lucky\nGuess, but you need to\nwatch the trials before{page_break}choosing a fighter.{end_wait}
A warrior named {actor_name:1}\nwas picked by Babi. That\nsounds like a safe bet.{page_break}Maybe too safe.{end_wait}
I've played Lucky Guess for\nyears without winning once.\nMaybe today's my day.{end_wait}
A fighter who skipped the\ntrials gets a place in the\nfinals? Tell me that's{page_break}fair.{end_wait}
I wonder who'll make the\nfinals. I've got my eye on\na few of them.{end_wait}
No more trials. Now we find\nout who can actually fight.{end_wait}
When those gates close,\nColosso really is over.\nI'll miss the noise.{end_wait}
If you don't arrive before\ndawn, you end up standing\noutside. I hate it.{end_wait}
I picked {actor_name:1} in Lucky\nGuess. Everyone says\n{actor_name:1} can fight. I hope{page_break}they're right.{end_wait}
After a week of shouting\nand cheering, these gates\nlook lonely. Same thing{page_break}every year.{end_wait}
Look how many people came\nlate. Tomorrow they'll all\nbe here before sunrise.{end_wait}
The rich buy the good seats\nand never have to queue.\nSome things never change.{end_wait}
I'm picking the biggest\nfighter. Bigger means\nstronger, doesn't it?{end_wait}
Babi's favorite might lose.\nThat's the thing about a\nreal fight. Nobody knows{page_break}until it's over.{end_wait}
This time I've got a\nwinner. I can feel it.{end_wait}
What's this {actor_name:1} like?\nBabi must see something in\nhim.{end_wait}
Everyone keeps raising the\nstakes. If an unpopular\nfighter wins, someone will{page_break}make a fortune.{end_wait}
Maybe I should buy a seat.\nBut I could eat for a week\nwith that money.{end_wait}
Every year I say I'll quit\nguessing. Then Colosso\ncomes around and here I am.{end_wait}
If I don't sell these\nseats, I'm the one who'll\nlose money. Anyone want a{page_break}ticket?{end_wait}
Once the trials end, the\ncrowd gets twice as loud.\nYou should see the gates{page_break}then.{end_wait}
The money from Lucky Guess\ngoes to Babi. People keep\nplaying anyway.{end_wait}
I'm Morgan, the top seed.\nThe other fighters should\nremember that.{end_wait}
You can't leave until the\nfinals are finished. Those\nare the rules.{end_wait}
We've been waiting so long\nI nearly fell asleep. It\nwas just like this at my{page_break}first Colosso.{end_wait}
Listen for the gong. That's\nwhen the finals begin.{end_wait}
